title: Defend: HMAC Final promotes NOT_COMPILED_IN to WC_HW_E — prevents MAC bypass
description: In crypto2dev_hmac Final path: if CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT returns EOPNOTSUPP/ENOSYS/ENOENT (mapped to NOT_COMPILED_IN), the code promotes this to WC_HW_E instead of CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. Why this is correct: by the time Final is called, one or more Update calls have already returned 0 (success) — wolfSSL's software HMAC path has no accumulated data. A CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE at Final would cause wolfSSL to call wc_HmacFinal on empty software state, computing HMAC over zero bytes with an all-zeros key and returning it as the correct MAC — a silent MAC bypass. WC_HW_E surfaces a hard failure. Do not change this to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE under any 'simplification' pressure. The same logic applies to the GCM and CBC cipher paths but is less critical there because init failure before write/finalize means no partial state has been claimed.
